driver_script:
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --partition=gpu
#SBATCH --gres=gpu:1
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=4
#SBATCH --mem=8G
#SBATCH --time=00:30:00
#SBATCH --array=0-17%1
#SBATCH --output=runs/grid-direct1154-%A-%a.log
set -euo pipefail
export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH
export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=/tmp/pyrite-1154-cuda UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/pyrite-uv-cache
export PYRITE_HOME=$PWD PYRITE_CATALOG=$PWD/src/pyrite/data/catalog PYRITE_USER_CATALOG=$PWD/user-catalog
export OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1
uv run --frozen --extra nvidia python - <<'PY'
import json, os, platform, runpy, time
from datetime import UTC,datetime
from pathlib import Path
from pyrite.validation.check_records import current_revision
ns=runpy.run_path('checks/axial_source_performance.py')
i=int(os.environ['SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID']); probe=i//3; seed=1154+i%3
cells=[1,1,2,2,2,3][probe]; points=[24,32,24,32,24,24][probe]; step=[5,5,5,5,2.5,5][probe]
count=int(os.environ.get('PROBE_COUNT','32'))
if os.environ.get('SMOKE')=='1': cells,points,step=1,12,50
start=time.perf_counter()
row=ns['worker'](('B',{},'grid-bound',0,count,seed,dict(cells=cells,points=points,step=step,backend='cuda')))
record=dict(status='research bound-population measurement; single-process CUDA context',revision=current_revision(),timestamp_utc=datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),host=platform.node(),settings=dict(case='B',mode='grid-bound',cells=cells,points=points,step=step,backend='cuda',count=count,seed=seed,workers=1,repeats=1),samples=[dict(wall_s=time.perf_counter()-start,chunks=[row])])
name='grid-smoke' if os.environ.get('SMOKE')=='1' else f'grid-direct-{i}'
Path(f'runs/{name}.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
PY

uncertainty: SEMs are across three root means. Grid refinements and model differences retain seed-pair covariance. Equal integer seeds across unlike unravellings do not imply shared random trajectories. Three roots give weak interval estimates; no equivalence test or admission inference.
timing: Request wall excludes driver imports/initial CUDA context, includes input/solver/projector construction and scoring; fibre wall includes its internal CPU pool startup. GPU callbacks use CPU full eigensolves plus transfers (observable_s). First seed may compile kernels; later seeds can reuse the on-disk kernel cache. All grid arms use an eight-sector full-spectral cache. No photon-source throughput is inferred.
accounting_differences: Fibre absorbing retained projection/window M=9 B=20 versus unprojected finite periodic grid with return flux and out-of-band sink.
Fibre electronic harmonic_max=4 and density grid32 versus all density harmonics represented by the selected real-space grid.
Continuum-string TDS versus discrete supercell transfer.
Projected exact no-jump/waiting-time evolution versus full-grid Strang/fixed-step MCWF.
Fibre starts with incident-weighted retained projection; grid starts with the full plane wave.
convergence_protocol: Before CUDA results: exposure changes <=5% and compatible with zero within twice paired seed-difference SEM for grid24->32, supercell2->3 and step5->2.5 at the tested bases. Results are a local convergence study, not a rigorous numerical error bound or full Bloch-sector extrapolation.

reference_grid.selection: Finest tested points-per-cell on the 2x2 supercell; separate 2->3-cell refinement at 24 points/cell and 5->2.5 angstrom refinement at 2x24 satisfy the declared local convergence criterion. No full joint-limit extrapolation is claimed.

convergence_verdict: All five predeclared local refinement comparisons pass the <=5% and <=2 paired-SEM criteria; observed exposure shifts are <=0.18%.
outcome: Reference grid exposure 2199(141) angstrom versus fibre 2103(25) angstrom. Grid-minus-fibre 96(117) angstrom across seed pairs: difference unresolved at this sampling precision. Population evidence only; no photon-yield equivalence or admission change. Retain CPU-first decision.
